title: SG ONLINE TUTOR - AI-Driven Automated Tuition Platform
description: Engineered an intelligent autonomous AI Agent powered by OpenAI to dynamically match users with courses and automate registration processes. Designed an advanced pro-rated pricing matrix integrated with Stripe Billing for automated next-month recurring cycles. Developed a time-triggered 9-stage automated marketing automation system utilizing Laravel Queues and configured Laravel Crons for dynamic session scheduling connected with Zoom and WhatsApp APIs.
challenges: Architected an autonomous AI workflow utilizing OpenAI Assistants for lead capture and course routing.
Implemented a complex pro-rated financial billing matrix for midway student enrollments.
Optimized background worker processes via Laravel Queues to reliably execute a 9-stage sequence of automated marketing emails without degrading core server performance.

title: ATHLETERATED - High-Scale Sports Platform & Legacy Migration
description: Executed a complex architectural migration and reverse engineering of a legacy Django backend to a modern, robust Laravel ecosystem. Architected a secure 5-tier role-based access control (RBAC) structure. Built complex live sports scoring calculation engines capable of processing automated data ingestion via CSV uploads and OCR image parsing. Integrated a unified global payment layer using Stripe and PayPal along with real-time push notifications using Firebase.
challenges: Successfully reverse-engineered app behaviors from a legacy Django codebase into optimized Laravel design patterns.
Designed and optimized mathematical calculation models for high-scale, real-time sports scoring pipelines.
Integrated OCR technology into backend jobs to securely parse text and ingest large batches of unstructured data from game images.

title: TIJARAH - Admin Console
description: Engineered a robust enterprise-grade Admin Console for the TIJARA Business Management application. Designed and deployed a secure, granular 7-tier role-based access control (RBAC) architecture to govern critical administration features. Built dynamic dashboard analytics layers and handled high-density dataset processing utilizing Server-side DataTables and optimized MySQL queries.
challenges: Designed a highly strict database schema and secure endpoints to manage operations for a production mobile app.
Enforced tight security constraints for Super Admin, Marketing, and Financial access points while protecting sensitive data records.

title: ELOUISA WEB APPLICATION
description: Designed and developed a highly scalable content delivery web application architecture for cross-platform Movies, TV Shows, Radio, and Live TV. Built a robust multi-role admin engine with custom permission guards and implemented clean, optimized RESTful APIs to maintain seamless, high-performance web and mobile views with minimal loading latencies.
challenges: Optimized complex database relations and caching mechanisms to handle high-frequency multimedia content indexing.
Developed secure, stateless JWT authentication and REST endpoints to achieve frictionless integration across mobile and web interfaces.
